vb_textbox.text: The gnomes are in pairs (red/purple) or (green/orange). Click through the colors of these pairs continuously until the return on mushrooms is +2 or less (1-0) and then switch color pairs. Size of hats for pairs didn't seem to matter that much for me (generally I got between +8 to +5) but that may be a factor, I just stuck to the easier color matching for quicker inputs and seemed to get a decent amount of points. Sometimes switching pairs requires going back and forth a bit to get the most, but in general I was on one color pair for 8 or so screens at a time so as long as the yield looks good you can continue on that route :-). Good luck!
